bailianAnthropicHint.title: Alibaba Cloud Bailian · Anthropic Messages mode
bailianAnthropicHint.body: Use Bailian's bare (lower-case) model names (e.g. qwen3-max, qwen3-coder-plus, glm-5, deepseek-v4-pro, MiniMax-M2.5). Don't include a vendor prefix (e.g. MiniMax/MiniMax-M2.7, ZHIPU/GLM-5). Keep Base URL on /compatible-mode/v1 — at runtime it auto-switches to /apps/anthropic/v1 for the Anthropic wire; Test Connection / Fetch Models continue to use the OpenAI-compat path.
